results.title: Price - Nodinite
results.snippet: Simple Transparent Pricing Nodinite uses a fixed-price subscription model based on your company size, not per user or usage volume. This means you pay one predictable annual cost regardless of how many users access the system, how many environments you run, or how many integrations you monitor.
